rules.description: Use one real produced song continuously; never synthesize music or add a second song.
Choose moving, relevant shots first; fit the beat grid and dialogue to them rather than filling a cut target with repeated shots.
For a dialogue pocket, show the actual speaker on camera with visible natural mouth movement; no muted talking face.
No frozen or repeated-frame runs; every shot must contain visible motion.
Dialogue must remain natural and tightly synchronized; verify with audio and frames, not graphs alone.
Cuts belong on the song's real musical beats; intense lines need a musical answer and the song must not stay flat.
No credit rolls, source watermarks, burned source names, or countdown artifacts from the source footage.
The ending must feel deliberate and smooth, not an abrupt direct stop.
